Because the observed proxy shows a reversal rather than a stable drift and batch-level sign agreement is weak, none of the offered recipes is justified by this evidence; the incumbent constant dose (dose_factors=1, M2 reward, frozen temperatures) is retained. This is a deferral, not a rejection of the dose lane: a batch-stable sign profile or a cross-feature consistent trend would justify revisiting a registered recipe.
